minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, August 18, 2021
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, August 18, 2021.
  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Lorraine Missick, Jenny Jolly, and
  Scott Snider.
  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Manager and Amanda Triay,
  Community Services Specialist.
  Guests present: None.
  A moment of silence was observed in honor of Chick.
  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, July 15,
  2021 meeting, motion carried.

  Unfinished Business
2. Senior Nutrition Program: An average of 104 meals served per week to curbside
  recipients in June 2021 and 102 meals served per week to curbside recipients in
  July 2021.

3. Guest Speaker: None.

4. Bingo Report: Bingo opened in July as planned. The Bingo balance is $1870 of
  which $562 was spent on paper costs. Current attendance is at 44 but would like
  attendance to at least reach 50 participants to break even.

5. Meals on Wheels: Average of 50.2 meals served per day for June. Average of 51.1
  meals served per day in July

6. Account Balance: $3,321.93

7. Senior Program Fees: It was reported the spreadsheet shows monthly dues. Bridge
  and Wood Carvers returned.

8. Mt. SAC Classes: Class schedule and class registration may be found online on the
  Mt. SAC website.
 9. Aging Next: In June, helped 21 La Verne residents. In July, 17 La Verne residents
  utilized Aging Next and also 2 meals were delivered.

  New Business

10. Upcoming Events:
  Wednesday, August 25th – Line Dancing Class, Beginners Class 2-3:00 PM and
  Intermediate Class 3-4:00 PM
  st
  Wednesday, September 1 – Sawdust Festival and Pageant of the Masters
  Excursion, 1-11:45 PM and the cost is $99
  Monday, September 13th – Movie Matinee, 12:30 PM

11. Facilities Report: The tract lighting was updated in the Community Center.
  Emergency lighting was also updated and the roof leak has been repaired. There
  are plans to paint the outside of the Community Center. Veterans Hall held a COVID
  complaint event which went well. Veterans Hall’s restrooms have been completed
  and are ADA compliant; it was also newly painted and the ceiling tiles were
  replaced. The Senior Lounge remains closed until further notice.

12. Public Comments: George gave an update on Senior Golf and has sign ups going
  on. Golf carts can now be shared and all is going well at Marshall Canyon.

  Scott: No public events at Hillcrest. Staff maybe fully vaccinated soon.

  Amanda: Currently trying to bring back the Health Fair and the dinner dances.
  Chick’s memorial date will be announced.

13. Adjourn: A motion was moved and seconded to adjourn the meeting, motion
  approved and carried. The meeting was adjourned at 11:10 AM. Next meeting will
  be held at the Community Center on September 15, 2021 at 10:00 AM.
